grid.layout_notes: Sheet branding 5×4; xWays expands reel heights (2–3 symbols).

win_system.notes: xWays/Infectious xWays expand ways. Exact base ways not printed.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: xWays holds 2–3 of same symbol expanding height. With Wild → Infectious xWays expands all same-kind symbols on reel to that size.

other.name: Infectious xWays
other.how_it_works: Triggered when xWays + Wild; revealed symbol expands matching symbols on the reel to same size.

wilds.name: Wild
wilds.behavior: Ordinary wilds; with xWays trigger Infectious xWays. In Lock n' Load may lock with x2/x3 mult.

scatters.name: Bonus
scatters.behavior: 3 or 4 → choose Toxic Hazard or Lock n' Load (4 awards +1 spin). 5 → Mayhem Mode. Collecting 5 total in feature also enters Mayhem.

specials.name: xWays / Infectious xWays
specials.behavior: xWays reveals one kind expanding 2–3 high; +Wild → Infectious expansion of matching symbols.

base_game_loop.summary: 5×4 ways spin focused on xWays; Wild+xWays creates Infectious expansion. 3–4 Bonus → choose Toxic Hazard (9/10) or Lock n' Load (7/8); 5 Bonus or collect 5 in feature → Mayhem (12/10). Buy 75–555×.

phases.name: Spin
phases.what_happens: Reels stop; resolve xWays and Infectious xWays with Wilds.

phases.name: Bonus choice
phases.what_happens: 3/4 Bonus → choose Toxic Hazard or Lock n' Load; 5 → Mayhem.

modes.name: Toxic Hazard
modes.trigger: 3 or 4 Bonus; player chooses Toxic Hazard.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: 1–5 random wilds on middle reels each spin (xWays → Infectious likely).

phases.name: Toxic
phases.what_happens: Play with random middle wilds each spin.

modes.name: Lock n' Load
modes.trigger: 3 or 4 Bonus; player chooses Lock n' Load.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: All Wilds lock for feature; may get x2/x3; xWays guaranteed Infectious.

phases.name: Lock
phases.what_happens: Locking wilds with optional mults; Infectious on xWays.

modes.name: Mayhem Mode
modes.trigger: 5 Bonus from base, or collect total 5 Bonus during Infectious Spins.
modes.spins_awarded: 12 or 10 spins (sheet lists both; CMS '12 or 10')

phases.name: Mayhem
phases.what_happens: Top Infectious Spins tier from 5 Bonuses.

bonus_free_spins.notes: Mayhem lists both 12 and 10 on sheet/CMS — left as stated, not invented.

features.name: xWays & Infectious xWays
features.effects: Expand 2–3 high; Infectious expands matching symbols on reel.

features.name: Nolimit Bonus Buy
features.effects: Buy into Toxic / Lock n' Load / Mayhem.

options.name: Nolimit Bonus — 3 features
options.effects: Buy one of the three Infectious Spins modes.

numeric_limits.hit_frequency_notes: Hit frequency 31.34%; free spins 1 in 220; win 100× 1 in 840.

## Wilds
Ordinary wilds, but very potent together with xWays symbol.

## xWays & Infectious xWays
You’ve seen these before in East Coast vs West Coast - but this game is only dedicated to the Infectious xWays. xWays mystery symbol will reveal one symbol of the same kind, but expand the reels as they hold 2-3 symbols.\nLand a xWays symbol and a Wild, to trigger the Infectious xWays symbol - where the revealed symbol will also expand any symbol of the same kind on the reel to the same size!

## Infectious Spins
Land 3 or 4 bonus symbols to trigger the bonus mode - and choose between Toxic Hazard and Lock n’ Load bonus modes. Landing 4 bonus symbols award +1 extra spin in each mode.

## Infectious Spins: Toxic Hazard (9 or 10 spins)
For the ones that is looking for a more solid payout from Infectious Spins, where 1-5 random wilds are placed on the middle reels for every spin - which means that landing an xWays means instant Infectious Ways with a good chance of a winning connection!
